summary.text: Mitchell Jacob, a Democratic public defender, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Oklahoma's 4th District to Tom Cole.

A Tulsa native and U.S. Army veteran who served as a Sergeant and Cryptologic Linguist, he earned a law degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2025 and ran for the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell Jacob was born in Tulsa, Oklahoma, and describes himself as a fourth-generation Oklahoman.
He earned a high school diploma from Boulder Creek High School, an associate degree from Rio Salado College in 2016, and a bachelor's degree from Grand Canyon University in 2019.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2022 as a Sergeant and Cryptologic Linguist, and deployed to southern Syria in support of Operation Inherent Resolve.
After his service, Jacob earned a law degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2025.
His career experience includes work as a stockbroker, banker, mortgage loan originator and public defender.
He was the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 20 in 2024, losing to Republican Jonathan Wilk, 75.8% to 24.2%.
Jacob says he is a father of five and lives in Newcastle, Oklahoma, with his wife and children.
He said his campaign focused on fiscal responsibility, public education and criminal justice reform.
He received 39.5% of the vote to Tom Cole's 57.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
